baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated ر ز ق verb-noun pair presents provision as an apportioned gift, while م س ك makes that gift something its giver can actively hold back. The conditional therefore tests whether any substitute giver exists when the provision remains under its owner's control.

activation_trace.role: The paired act and object activate apportioned giving: He provides, and the provision is His.
The condition activates holding and preventing, placing continued access to the gift under the same agent's control.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks generally who could provide if provision stopped.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks who could replace the ongoing giver if He actively held back the apportioned gift that remains His.

baseline_models.mechanism: The adversative بَل shifts from the failed provider challenge to a three-stage response: continued obstinacy, proud refusal of obedience, and active distancing. The clause describes maintained movement away from the implication of dependence, not a single lapse of attention.

activation_trace.role: The verb marks persistence and going on in obstinate contention.
The first state names proud excess beyond obedience.
The second state adds recoil and distancing from what should be acknowledged.

changed_reading.before: They remain generically stubborn and averse.
changed_reading.after: They persist in a proud refusal that expresses itself as active recoil from acknowledged dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to eat from His رِزْق places the same noun inside ordinary bodily sustenance. It activates the food branch without exhausting the broader apportioned-gift branch.

activation_trace.role: The phrase كُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ links His provision directly to what is eaten.

structural_cues: 67:15 supplies the earlier phrase رِّزْقِهِ, and 67:21 repeats the possessive as رِزْقَهُ.
The movement across the earth and command to eat make the prior occurrence concrete before the later withholding question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The threatened loss includes daily, embodied sustenance, while the possessive still keeps the category wider than food alone.

changed_reading.before: His provision is a broad, unspecified benefit.
changed_reading.after: His provision remains broad but now has ordinary food and bodily maintenance as its nearest established instance.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:15, B001 remains secure but the B002 food specification loses its direct contextual anchor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding image says that none but the Merciful holds the birds aloft. Repetition of م س ك in 67:21 reverses the polarity from sustaining hold to withholding, so deprivation is heard as the sovereign suspension of an ongoing support rather than mere non-giving.

activation_trace.role: يُمْسِكُهُنَّ supplies the positive sustaining use of the same holding root.
The exclusive holder is named the Merciful, tying sustaining control to mercy rather than impersonal mechanism.

structural_cues: 67:19 and 67:21 repeat forms of م س ك across one intervening ayah.
The exclusive construction مَا ... إِلَّا in 67:19 prepares the no-substitute question in 67:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The provider is also the one continuously maintaining creation; withholding provision is the negative counterpart of His merciful holding.

changed_reading.before: أَمْسَكَ means a one-time refusal to hand over a benefit.
changed_reading.after: أَمْسَكَ evokes the withdrawal of continuously maintained access by the same Merciful agent who holds creatures aloft.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:19, withholding remains valid, but its contrast with merciful, continuous holding disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah denies any force that could help apart from the Merciful and calls confidence in such protection delusion. The identical opening challenge in 67:21 transfers that denial from military protection to provision: neither defender nor provider can operate independently of Him.

activation_trace.role: The supposed army's aid is the first denied substitute agency.
مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ makes the denial explicitly exclusive of any alternative to the Merciful.
غُرُورٍ characterizes imagined independent protection as a deceptive appearance that cannot hold.

structural_cues: 67:20 and 67:21 begin with the same challenge, أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى.
The paired questions move from يَنصُرُكُم to يَرْزُقُكُمْ, testing protection and sustenance in succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The question is not seeking the name of another provider; its parallel form exposes every proposed substitute as no more real than the imagined protecting army.

changed_reading.before: The provision question stands as an isolated hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: It is the second half of a coordinated denial of substitute agencies: no independent protector and no independent provider.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:20, exclusive provision remains inferable, but the repeated challenge and explicit classification of substitute reliance as delusion are lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah immediately converts moral response into opposed ways of moving: one gait is contrasted with upright movement on a straight path. That spatial contrast strengthens نُفُور as directed movement away and lets عُتُوّ register as refusal of upright alignment.

activation_trace.role: The repeated walking verb turns the moral contrast into two enacted trajectories.
The comparison explicitly evaluates which trajectory is better guided toward the true path.
سَوِيًّا contributes bodily and moral uprightness as the positive opposite of recoil.
The path supplies the destination-bearing frame for the motion.
مُّسْتَقِيمٍ marks straightness and balanced alignment, opposed to proud deviation.

structural_cues: 67:22 follows the عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ clause without changing the addressee or argumentative scene.
Its two occurrences of يَمْشِي and its path vocabulary spatialize the preceding behavioral pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The refusal in 67:21 is not static inner dislike; it has a direction and yields a disordered way of proceeding.

changed_reading.before: نُفُورٍ is an undirected feeling of aversion.
changed_reading.after: نُفُورٍ is heard as active distancing that leads into the next ayah's contrast between misdirected and upright travel.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:22, B001 of ن ف ر still means distancing, but the embodied path-and-direction reading is much weaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: After describing created faculties, the text says that gratitude is scarce. This diagnoses the obstinacy of 67:21 as a recipient's failure to recognize gifts, not merely an argumentative temperament.

activation_trace.role: تَشْكُرُونَ names recognition of blessing and praise of the giver as the missing response.

structural_cues: 67:23 follows the provision challenge and walking comparison with a list of bestowed human faculties.
قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ supplies an explicit evaluative diagnosis of the audience's response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Their persistence in pride and recoil is sharpened as ingratitude toward the giver whose gifts make perception and response possible.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause reports generalized defiance.
changed_reading.after: The closing clause depicts the beneficiaries of provision persisting in a refusal that the next lines identify as failed gratitude.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 67:23, the defiance remains clear, but its specific relation to unrecognized gifts is less explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The closing water question activates a concrete B003 subimage inside the broader B001 provision model; it does not license reducing every occurrence of رِزْق to water.

activation_trace.role: The focus root has a latent branch in which descending rain or water is named provision.
The surah's closing challenge names water twice as the indispensable substance at risk.
Water sinking into depth supplies a concrete image of provision becoming inaccessible.
The question of who can bring it repeats the focus ayah's challenge to identify an alternative supplier.
مَعِينٍ culminates in the image of an accessible flowing spring.

changed_reading.before: The loss of provision remains a generic hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: The terminal image of vanished water gives the hypothetical a concrete limiting case: no one else can restore the most basic life-bearing provision.

discarded_or_unchanged: م س ك B002 (miserly withholding) is not activated: 67:19 frames holding as merciful sovereign control, not blameworthy stinginess.
ل ج ج remains B001 (obstinate persistence); neither the later water image nor lexical availability justifies importing B002 (the sea's deep expanse) into the syntax of لَّجُّوا.
ن ف ر remains B001 (recoil and distancing). The army vocabulary in 67:20 does not turn نُفُورٍ into B002 military mobilization because فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ and 67:22's path contrast constrain it.
The broad B001 sense of ر ز ق remains primary even after 67:15 strengthens food and 67:30 activates water as concrete instances.

strongest_changes: 67:15 gives the broad category of His provision an established edible and bodily instance.
67:19 reverses the same م س ك root from mercifully holding birds aloft to hypothetically holding provision back, making deprivation the withdrawal of sustaining control.
67:20's repeated challenge denies substitute protection before 67:21 denies substitute provision.
67:22-23 recast pride and recoil as misoriented movement and failed gratitude.
67:30's inaccessible water concretizes, without exhausting, the withheld-provision hypothesis.
summary.what_was_special: 67:21 is a hinge between two tightly linked sequences: it completes the no-substitute challenges of 67:19-20 and opens the diagnosis of misorientation and ingratitude in 67:22-23. The repeated م س ك root and the final water question make dependence feel continuous, concrete, and impossible to outsource.
remaining_uncertainties: The water branch is best treated as a contextual concretization, but the packet alone cannot establish that رِزْقَهُ is lexically restricted to water here.
67:22 clearly continues the argument, though the degree to which its path imagery modifies نُفُور specifically rather than the whole عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ pair remains interpretive.
The packet's remote orientation is non-citable, so no external orientation claim is used.
